name: ProductOptions
summary: Presents the numbered choices of a product clarification, such as two interpretations of a word or several matching buyers.

props.name: options
props.meaning: Generated SDK agent result with the dimension, the asked words and numbered option labels.

props.name: onChoose
props.meaning: Sends the chosen number as the next message; absent for earlier turns, which show the options as text.

accessibility: A group named by its title; each choice is a native button whose text includes its number, so typing the number is equivalent.
usage: Option labels can be personal data such as buyer names: they appear only in this result, never in the reply text that later turns send to the model.

examples.label: Two interpretations
examples.description: Synthetic choices; selecting one shows a local message and makes no request.
